_about: The ONE golden pin for the first-week words. Inputs are the shapes the 2026-11-16 staging probe captured as a Free v2 org (keel_plan_usage at the start, keel_backtest_run notices at 37 and 18 left, the wall at 75 of 75). Since plans v3 (PLANS-REVIEW R16) a bonus that ends by the reset reads as the period's allowance beside it, '(25 plus your first-week 50); resets to 25 on Dec 16', and the notice's plan clause follows THE near rule (37 left of 75 is about half used: no clause). tests/test_plan_limits_first_week_golden.py reads it.
